description:
Presets tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- list_style_presets: List Draftless style presets.
- apply_style_preset: Compose a Draftless style preset with a subject/image into a ready-to-run payload.
- list_reel_templates: List the curated Reels templates from the Draftless Reels studio: beat sheet, captions, aspect ratio and the video model each one runs on.
- list_faceless_templates: List the Faceless Studio templates for narrated YouTube-style videos: tone, runtime, aspect ratio, visual mode (clip or still), music brief 
- list_faceless_styles: List the Faceless Studio art styles.
- list_explainer_presets: List the 22 Faceless explainer presets.
- list_poster_presets: List the 12 layered-poster looks.
- list_product_shot_presets: Browse the 282 product-shot presets: scene recipes that put the user's OWN product photo into a styled shot (studio white, lifestyle, outdoo
- resolve_explainer_preset: Resolve one Faceless explainer preset.
- list_saas_video_templates: List deterministic, editable SaaS launch-video templates, including their semantic product-kit slots, scene timing, format support and audio
- list_brand_kits: List the caller's brand kits (id, name, updated_at).

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).
